description: AI-generated original songs supplied by Goma DJ. Vocal songs (ACE-Step 1.5, English lyrics) come as a set of a DJ intro (Puck voice) plus the song; instrumental tracks (lo-fi / chiptune BGM) are song-only. Each entry carries a shelf tag (用途別の棚) so other projects can reuse tracks by purpose.
name: goma-ai-songs
